primary_user_goal: Understand Cal.com's value as a scheduling solution
primary_business_goal: Convert visitors to signup or self-host
copy_summary: Hero headline 'Scheduling infrastructure for everyone' with emphasis on open-source and self-hosting options. Product demo animation shows booking flow. Trust badges from notable companies.
notes: Clean, modern design with dark and light mode options. The open-source angle is prominently featured, differentiating from Calendly. Self-host option visible early shows developer-friendliness. Company logos provide strong social proof.

primary_business_goal: Drive paid conversions while maintaining free tier adoption
copy_summary: Four-tier pricing: Free, Team, Organization, Enterprise. Feature comparison matrix. Generous free tier for individuals. Monthly/yearly toggle with savings shown.
notes: Transparent pricing with generous free tier creates trust. Self-host option is unique differentiator. Feature comparison is scannable. The 'most popular' tag guides choice without being pushy.

primary_user_goal: See available meeting types and select one to book
primary_business_goal: Enable easy discovery and selection of booking options
copy_summary: Public booking page showing host profile, bio, and available event types as clickable cards. Each event type shows duration and brief description.
notes: Clean, branded booking page creates professional impression. Event type cards are scannable. Host photo and bio build trust. Minimal distractions keep focus on booking action. Mobile-responsive design works on all devices.

primary_user_goal: Find and select an available time slot
primary_business_goal: Minimize friction in time selection to maximize booking completion
copy_summary: Calendar view on left showing available dates (highlighted). Time slots on right grouped by time of day. Timezone prominently displayed with easy switching.
notes: The calendar clearly shows available vs unavailable dates. Auto-detected timezone prevents errors. Time slots are chunked by morning/afternoon/evening for scannability. Smooth transitions maintain context.

primary_user_goal: Provide contact details to confirm booking
copy_summary: Booking summary on left (event type, date, time, timezone). Form on right collecting name, email, and optional notes. Custom questions if configured by host.
notes: Minimal required fields reduce friction. Booking summary provides confirmation of selection. Guest can add guests for group bookings. Optional fields clearly marked. No account required to book.

primary_user_goal: Confirm booking was successful and get calendar invite
primary_business_goal: Ensure booking completion and reduce no-shows
copy_summary: Success message with checkmark. Full booking details displayed. Add to calendar buttons for Google, Outlook, Apple, and ICS download. Reschedule and cancel links.
notes: Clear success state with checkmark provides instant feedback. Multiple calendar options ensure compatibility. Self-service reschedule and cancel reduce host burden. Email confirmation is sent automatically.

primary_user_goal: View and manage upcoming and past bookings
primary_business_goal: Drive daily engagement and booking management
copy_summary: Left sidebar with navigation. Main area shows booking list with tabs for Upcoming, Recurring, Past, Cancelled. Each booking shows attendee, event type, date/time, and action buttons.
notes: Clean booking management interface. Quick actions (reschedule, cancel, join) are accessible. Filter by event type or date range. Empty states guide new users. Responsive layout works on mobile.

primary_business_goal: Enable creation of diverse booking options
copy_summary: Grid of event type cards showing name, duration, link. Toggle to enable/disable. Quick actions for edit, duplicate, delete. Team event types tab for collaborative scheduling.
notes: Event type cards are scannable with key info visible. Enable/disable toggle is intuitive. Duplicate feature speeds up creation of similar event types. Link preview shows how booking page will look.

primary_business_goal: Enable powerful customization while maintaining simplicity
copy_summary: Tabbed settings: Event Setup, Availability, Assignment, Limits, Advanced. Event setup shows title, description, URL, duration, location options. Preview button to see public page.
notes: Tabbed interface organizes complex settings logically. Smart defaults mean most users only need to set title and duration. Advanced options hidden but accessible. Location options include video conferencing, phone, in-person, and custom.

primary_business_goal: Ensure accurate availability to prevent booking conflicts
copy_summary: Weekly schedule editor showing each day with time ranges. Add multiple time blocks per day. Set schedule name and timezone. Copy times to multiple days.
notes: Visual schedule editor is intuitive. Multiple schedules supported for different scenarios. Copy time feature saves repetitive input. Timezone setting prevents confusion for remote teams. Default schedule clearly marked.

copy_summary: Integration grid organized by category: Calendars, Video Conferencing, Payment, Automation, CRM. Each integration shows logo, name, description, and connect status. Search to find specific integrations.
notes: Rich integration ecosystem displayed clearly. Categories help discovery. Connected integrations show status with disconnect option. Calendar integrations are prioritized as most critical. OAuth flows are streamlined.
